content.text: The digital product economy is structurally unfair to creators in restricted markets. The tools that Western creators take for granted — Stripe for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-works-how|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-stack-started-generating-2|The Payment]]s, Gumroad for storefront and delivery, PayPal for international transfers — are either unavailable or functionally broken for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and dozens of other markets. The answer is not finding a better platform. The answer is removing the platform layer entirely. A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you a storefront you host, a payment processor that runs on blockchain rails, and an [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-ebook-delivery-after-crypto-payment-what-actually-7|automated]] delivery system that sends your product within 30 seconds of payment confirmation. You collect revenue directly into a wallet you control. You convert to local currency through P2P exchanges at near-market rates. The platform cannot suspend you because you are not on any platform.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-what-actually-how-7. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

The architecture behind selling Notion templates without traditional payment processors consists of easily deployable stacks that automate sales and payment processing. This architecture allows creators to maintain full ownership of their products and data while leveraging cryptocurrency for transactions. In regions where conventional platforms are unavailable, this solution not only enables digital sales but also protects creators from platform fees, ensuring they keep more of their revenue.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, this architecture uses a combination of free hosting services and automated payment processors like NOWPayments. By deploying your store on platforms such as Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages, you create a stable environment for your products. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments processes the cryptocurrency transaction with a minimal fee of 0.5%, which is significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad that charge up to 10%. This structure not only enables seamless sales but also automates product delivery, providing an efficient experience for both creators and buyers.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed specifically for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are either unavailable or prohibitively expensive. Whether you are selling ebooks, courses, templates, or other digital products, this architecture empowers you to reach your audience without being hindered by financial barriers. By embracing this model, creators can focus on what they do best—creating—while the infrastructure manages sales and payment processing.
Keep 99.5% of your earnings with lower transaction fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The architecture includes several key components: a hosting platform like Cloudflare Pages, a backend logic processor such as Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments for handling cryptocurrency transactions. These components work in unison to create a streamlined sales funnel. Products are stored and delivered through platforms like Supabase or Google Drive, ensuring that customers receive instant access to their purchases. Each element is chosen for its reliability and cost-effectiveness, allowing creators to maximize their profits.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first select a hosting platform like Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages for your digital products. Next, set up a payment processing solution through NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrencies. Load your products into a storage system like Supabase, and configure automated delivery using Google Apps Script. Finally, promote your store to your audience and watch as transactions occur without traditional payment barriers. The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides all the documentation you need to deploy your store quickly and efficiently.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Automate product delivery with minimal effort.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

You can use a combination of free hosting and NOWPayments to sell templates and fonts. By deploying your products on platforms like Cloudflare Pages and integrating NOWPayments, you eliminate reliance on traditional platforms while ensuring low transaction fees.
What are the advantages of using cryptocurrency for transactions?

Cryptocurrency transactions offer lower fees and faster processing times compared to traditional payment processors. With NOWPayments, you only incur a 0.5% fee, allowing you to retain more of your revenue and provide a better experience for your customers.
Is it difficult to set up my own online store without Stripe or PayPal?

Setting up your online store without Stripe or PayPal is straightforward with the right tools. By using platforms like Cloudflare Pages and integrating NOWPayments, you can create an efficient sales process in just a few steps, even without technical expertise.
Can I automate product delivery to my customers?

Yes, you can automate product delivery using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. This ensures that customers receive their purchases instantly after payment confirmation, enhancing their experience and eliminating manual tasks.
What kind of products can I sell using this infrastructure?

This infrastructure supports a wide range of digital products, including ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. You have the flexibility to sell any digital goods while maintaining full ownership and control.
